title: Unused Script
description:
Unused-code rule — scripts never called by another script, a button or a custom menu and never started by a trigger. Scripts in the Scripts menu are entry points: they are listed separately and are not findings. Findings in files exported without DDR info are marked unverified.

Based on the PMD rule UnusedPrivateMethod — https://docs.pmd-code.org/latest/pmd_rules_java_bestpractices.html#unusedprivatemethod
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Dead scripts inflate the solution, slow analysis and hide intent.
rule.remediation: Confirm the script is not started manually / from a custom menu / externally, then delete it. In a file exported without DDR info formula references are missing, so its findings are marked unverified — export it again with DDR info before deleting.
